<style>
.xr{font-family:'Segoe UI',Calibri,Arial,sans-serif;color:#1f2937;max-width:182mm;margin:0 auto;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}
.xr table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
.xr-page{page-break-after:always;margin-bottom:28px}.xr-page:last-child{page-break-after:auto;margin-bottom:0}
.xr-head td{background:#1e3a8a;color:#fff;padding:14px 18px}
.xr-school{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bfdbfe}
.xr-title{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
.xr-sub{font-size:12px;color:#dbeafe;margin-top:2px}
.xr-date{font-size:11px;color:#bfdbfe;text-align:right}
.xr-id td{background:#eff6ff;border:1px solid #bfdbfe;border-top:0;padding:11px 18px}
.xr-name{font-size:19px;font-weight:700;color:#1e3a8a}
.xr-meta{font-size:11.5px;color:#4b5563;margin-top:2px}
.xr-kpis{margin:14px 0 4px;border-collapse:separate!important;border-spacing:8px 0}
.xr-kpis td{border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-top:3px solid #2563eb;background:#fff;padding:9px 6px;text-align:center;vertical-align:middle}
.xr-kl{font-size:9.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#6b7280;font-weight:600}
.xr-kv{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#111827;margin-top:2px}
.xr-h{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#1e3a8a;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;border-bottom:2px solid #1e3a8a;padding-bottom:3px;margin:18px 0 8px}
.xr-cat{background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:700;color:#374151;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb}
.xr td.c,.xr th.c{text-align:center}
.xr-t th{background:#f9fafb;color:#4b5563;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;text-align:left;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb}
.xr-t td{padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;vertical-align:top}
.xr-t tr:nth-child(even) td{background:#fafafa}
.xr-chip{display:inline-block;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid}
.xr-hi{background:#dcfce7;color:#166534;border-color:#86efac}.xr-ok{background:#dbeafe;color:#1e40af;border-color:#93c5fd}.xr-mid{background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e;border-color:#fcd34d}.xr-lo{background:#fee2e2;color:#991b1b;border-color:#fca5a5}.xr-na{background:#f3f4f6;color:#6b7280;border-color:#d1d5db}
.xr-box{border:1px solid #e5e7eb;border-radius:6px;padding:10px 12px;vertical-align:top}
.xr-bar{height:8px;background:#e5e7eb;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}.xr-bar div{height:8px;background:#16a34a}
.xr-comment{border:1px solid #bfdbfe;background:#f8fbff;border-radius:6px;padding:11px 13px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;min-height:48px}
.xr-sign td{padding-top:30px;font-size:11px;color:#6b7280;width:50%}.xr-line{border-top:1px solid #6b7280;padding-top:3px;margin-right:30px}
.xr-foot{margin-top:14px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid #e5e7eb;font-size:10px;color:#9ca3af;text-align:center}
.xr-two>tbody>tr>td{vertical-align:top}
.xr-li{padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #f3f4f6;font-size:11.5px}
</style>
